description: Number → text. `string`: String(x), the ECMAScript Number::toString used by template literals and hashGraph. `json`: JSON.stringify(x) (non-finite → null). `exponential`: x.toExponential() (shortest digits), used for canonical xsd:double lexical forms. `fixed`: x.toFixed(0), x.toFixed(1), x.toFixed(2): digits of the exact binary value, a tie rounded away from zero, -0 → "0", String(x) from 1e21 on; used for JSON-LD integers and byte sizes in messages.
